mapper.select: select id, title, subtitle, together_since, about, comment_mode from site_setting where id = 1
mapper.insert: insert into site_setting (id, title, subtitle, together_since, about, comment_mode) values (1, #{title}, #{subtitle}, #{togetherSince}, #{about}, #{commentMode})
mapper.update: update site_setting set title = #{title}, subtitle = #{subtitle}, together_since = #{togetherSince}, about = #{about}, comment_mode = #{commentMode} where id = 1
